name: Scoa
source: CRON 20261014: SCOA Nigeria Plc unaudited consolidated statement of comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), current period 2026 column, N'000 scaled to naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed Gross profit and Profit Before Tax less Taxation equals the printed Profit after Tax. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.derivedFrom: finance income less finance costs, both printed on the statement of profit or loss

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2023; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024, FY2022: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
source_note: FY2025 Net Finance Costs filled from the FY2025 statement of profit or loss: finance income 42,480 thousand, finance costs nil. Convention proved against FY2024, where 4,013 less 1,144 reproduces the stored 2,869 thousand.
